comments.body: I think something to keep in mind for US students applying to MS programs in Europe is that generally speaking, European university’s curriculum tends to be more theoretical and hence more math intense. I suggest you not only take linear algebra and analysis (and there are several branches such as real, differential, etc.), but you think about going back to school and brushing up on statistics as well (seeing that you show interest in DS too). And by statistics, I mean taking beyond your intro probability class such as stochastic processes.
comments.author: AZfoodie
